rates.note: Each percentage is numerator / denominator, rounded to one decimal. Per-package and per-domain rows use the classes of that package or domain as the denominator and cover class-based rates only.

rates.label: God classes
rates.numerator_definition: classes that exceed at least the rule's minimum number of size or coupling thresholds

rates.label: Highly coupled classes
rates.numerator_definition: classes whose fan-in plus fan-out exceeds the coupling threshold

rates.label: Classes in dependency cycles
rates.numerator_definition: classes that belong to a strongly connected group of two or more classes

rates.label: Classes with too many dependencies
rates.numerator_definition: classes that reference more distinct types than the threshold

rates.label: Classes calling deprecated APIs

rates.label: Classes using aging frameworks

rates.denominator_definition: all dependency edges whose source is a presentation-layer class
rates.label: Controller dependencies on entities
